## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the release gate before merge because it blocks releases that meet the configured approval minimum.

## Changes

The pull request regenerates the deployment catalog with production service names and ports, simplifies the service health predicate, and changes the release approval comparison.

## Critical

- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Accept releases that meet the approval minimum — With two approvals and the default minimum of two, `approved` returns `False`. The new `>` comparison excludes equality, although `zzz-release/gate.py:1` requires “at least the configured number of approvals.” — Releases with exactly the configured minimum stay blocked until they receive an extra approval. — Fix: Restore `>=` and extend `test_approved_release` to cover equality.
